example_sentences_in_bangla: স্কুলে খোশনবিশ ছাত্রদের বিশেষ পুরস্কার দেওয়া হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Students with beautiful handwriting receive special awards in school.
history: Derived from Persian words 'khosh' (beautiful) and 'navis' (writer), reflecting historical linguistic influences in Bengali.
note: This idiom highlights appreciation for calligraphy in traditional Bengali education and correspondence.
